summary: Former tower site in Craig County, Virginia; the Association lists it as gone, and the sources read say nothing more about its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Association; no source read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Tower in Craig County, listed as Gone
Forest Lookouts places the Rocky Gap entry in Craig County

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the Association's Virginia list (Tower, Gone, coordinates) and the Forest Lookouts Virginia list (Rocky Gap under Craig County, with no further detail) support the story. Two searches and several page reads found no build date, design, staffing, removal date, agency or photo. A guessed firetower.org register URL returned 404. Rocky Gap is also a community in Bland County, Virginia, so the name alone is ambiguous; the Association's coordinates (37.37278, -80.43972) and the Craig County entry tie this record to Craig County. Access is unknown. The story is shorter than the 120-word guide because the evidence is that thin.
